about: Every public First Officer promise, the system behind it, and how it was checked. Pages, the Terms, bot fact sheets and the app read from this file; tools/check_promises.py fails when a page contradicts it. Update it in the same change as any page, prompt or system it describes.

desk.promise: $550 a month, billed monthly, month to month, renews until cancelled

cancel.promise: Cancel any time in the Stripe Customer Portal or by messaging the thread; service runs to the end of the paid period

award_booking.promise: $500 per itinerary, for desk clients; non-refundable once the search begins

first_award_booking_free.promise: The first award booking is free
first_award_booking_free.backed_by: WhatsApp checkout message (b2b_intake.ts) and fo-b2b-checkout fee_waived
first_award_booking_free.gap: Not yet stated in the Terms or on the site

independence.promise: No affiliate links; no issuer, bank or program pays First Officer

strategies.promise: Software-led; no person reviews a strategy or report before it is sent

bookings.promise: A person handles every award booking with the client

deletion.promise: Within 30 days after the subscription ends, or after a request, personal data is deleted and Plaid connections removed at Plaid
deletion.backed_by: fo-data-retention-sweep (cron daily 04:00 UTC): Plaid /item/remove, then delete_client_completely

kept_after_deletion.promise: Payment and tax records; a deletion note (deletion_audit: date and steps)

consent_records_after_deletion.promise: Today: deleted with the client (consent_log, consent_grants cascade)
consent_records_after_deletion.gap: Needs a HARD GATE migration; pages change only when it is live

raw_email.promise: Raw forwarded emails deleted within 24 hours

shared_layer_from_connections.promise: Only de-identified merchant and category patterns; never amounts or account details
shared_layer_from_connections.backed_by: spend_unmapped (pfc_detailed, pfc_primary, seen_count, example_merchant, first_seen, last_seen)

security.promise: Encrypted in transit and at rest; database access rules separate clients; no security certification today

friday_report.promise: Every Friday, one number in dollars

processors.name: Anthropic
processors.note: Claude API; no training without permission; retention per platform.claude.com API data retention page

processors.name: Google
processors.note: Calendar, Meet, Sheets, Analytics 4; Gemini only if voice-note transcription is on

processors.name: seats.aero
processors.note: award availability search: routes and dates, never identity

processors.name: Axiom
processors.note: only if AXIOM_TOKEN is set in production; confirm or remove

banned_claims.pattern: (?:person|human)\b[^.]{0,40}\bchecks? every strategy|checks? every strategy with a person
strategy change is approved by a person
contractually required to protect your data
banned_claims.why: not every processor has a contract (web search)

known_gaps.until: the next Terms version, after counsel
known_gaps.why: changing the Terms needs notice and re-acceptance
